name: Web Interface Guidelines
summary: A living checklist of small interaction details that make a web interface feel finished, with exact values.
description: A non-exhaustive list of interface details grouped into Interactivity, Typography, Motion, Touch, Optimizations, Accessibility and Design. Each item is a concrete rule — box-shadow focus rings, interaction animations under 200ms, 16px minimum input font size, ~0.96 press scale — with footnotes explaining the reasoning.
contains: 7 sections: interactivity, typography, motion, touch, optimizations, accessibility, design
